rationale: The camera was stolen by snatching from the customer's person on the Barcelona metro during the covered trip, and a police report was filed within 24 hours, so Baggage and Personal Effects theft applies (policy wording s.5; claims manual s.7 says theft from the person is never unattended belongings). Under the Electronics Plus add-on the camera and kit lens count as one item at $980 (below the $1,200 electronics limit, purchase receipt on file), less the $50 Premium deductible, giving $930 (claims manual s.6 and s.10); this is within the $1,000 approval limit so no sign-off is needed.
